relationships.subject: TGFA
relationships.evidence_quote: a significant increase in VEGFA mRNA and protein secretion was observed after stimulation of control fibroblasts (HPF-c) with rhTGFA

relationships.subject: oncogenic PIK3CA p.H1047R
relationships.evidence_quote: TGFA mRNA expression was shown to be induced in PIK3CAH1047R expressing ECs

relationships.subject: afatinib
relationships.evidence_quote: We also demonstrated that afatinib, an irreversible inhibitor of EGFR/ErbB1, ErbB2, and ErbB4, was able to decrease PIK3CAH1047R-induced lesion growth and vascularization.

relationships.subject: afatinib
relationships.evidence_quote: to decrease VEGF-A secretion from TGFA-stimulated control fibroblasts measured by ELISA

key_findings: TGFA induced by oncogenic PIK3CA p.H1047R drives paracrine VEGF-A secretion from stromal fibroblasts and EC proliferation in venous lesions.
Afatinib reduced lesion size and vascularization in a xenograft model.
